memories.text: Old shopping list: kettle, two pillowcases, batteries for the kitchen clock. Apparently the clock was never broken; the battery was upside down.
The spare key is in the blue tin behind the flour. Tell my sister before the weekend.
First swim in months. Six lengths, lots of resting, excellent mood afterward.
Grandma measures rice with a chipped teacup. Must photograph the cup, not just copy the recipe.
Comprar limones, jabón y una bombilla para el pasillo. Llevar la bolsa de tela.
Stopped for bread after work and walked home by the canal. That extra ten minutes made the evening feel longer.
Dentist Thursday at 9:20. Ask about the tooth that reacts to cold water.
The bathroom tap drips only when the handle is pushed all the way back. Washer size still unknown.
Read forty pages on the train and missed my stop. Good book, expensive chapter.
La tarta salió baja pero rica. Usar un molde más pequeño la próxima vez y no abrir el horno tan pronto.
Put a little aside each month for a winter coat. Repair the lining of this one first.
Packed lunch for work: lentil salad, apple, bread. Forgot the fork again.
The campsite has drinking water by the entrance, but the tap near the showers is labeled otherwise. Bring a larger bottle next time.
Sunday with my brother: chess, burnt toast, an argument about whether clouds have shadows. They do.
Idea: dibujar la misma esquina del barrio una vez al mes. Quiero ver cómo cambia la luz, no hacer dibujos perfectos.
“Leave room for the day to surprise you.” Found this on a scrap in my own handwriting; no memory of writing it.
Holiday gifts hidden under the spare duvet. The striped parcel is for Mum.
Notebook transcription: headache after work, probably forgot water again. Ate soup and went to bed early.
Borrowed the long ladder from the neighbor upstairs. Return it Saturday, with the paint wiped off.
La biblioteca reserva libros durante una semana. Recoger el de jardinería antes del viernes.
Made a budget on paper because the spreadsheet kept becoming a decorating project. Three columns are enough.
Clara prefers savory snacks to birthday cake. Cheese biscuits might be the answer.
Shoe repair receipt is inside the dictionary, under S. This seemed clever at the time.
A meeting ran late, so I missed the pottery class. Ask whether I can collect the little bowl next week.
El paseo junto al río está lleno de barro. Las botas viejas aguantaron; los calcetines, no.
Eye test booked for June 14 at 11. Bring current glasses and the scratched sunglasses.
Cold noodles: sesame paste, soy sauce, lime, warm water to loosen. Cucumber on top. More lime than seems sensible.
The ferry crossing was rough. Sitting near the middle helped. Keep crackers in the outside pocket next time.
My niece called a pine cone a tree pineapple. Keeping that forever.
Después del trabajo fui al mercado y compré demasiados tomates. Hacer salsa mañana y congelar en porciones pequeñas.
Bike lock sticks in rain. A tiny amount of graphite helped; oil just attracted grit last time.
Book club discussion wandered into everyone's childhood pets. Nobody seemed to mind.
Renew the library card, cancel the unused magazine, check whether the bus pass still saves money.
The living room window rattles when the wind comes from the east. Folded cardboard works temporarily.
Nota de una agenda vieja: la abuela quiere que le devuelva las fotos del verano. Hacer copias antes.
Work was noisy today. Sat in the quiet part of the library afterward and read about moths for no particular reason.
Start seeds in the egg carton by the bright window. Label them before everything becomes anonymous green.
The new soup needs acid, not more salt. A spoonful of lemon juice fixed the whole pot.
Paid the annual insurance bill. Put renewal month on the paper calendar so it stops feeling like a surprise.
Mamá contó otra vez la historia del tren equivocado. Esta vez apareció un detalle nuevo: llevaba una jaula vacía.
Hike packing: water, plasters, extra socks, orange, map. The orange was the best item.
Need a proper lunch break even when work is busy. Ten minutes outside helped my shoulders unclench.
Travel towel dries quickly but feels like wiping myself with a curtain. Still worth the space saved.
Found a used copy of the novel Dad loved. His favorite chapter was the one on the boat, according to Mum.
Cita con el fisioterapeuta el martes a las cuatro. Llevar pantalones cómodos y apuntar cuándo empezó la molestia.
The landlord replaced the faulty smoke alarm today. Test button works; date written inside the cupboard door.
Idea for a photo series: things repaired with visible stitches. Start with the red scarf.
After finishing a work deadline, I slept through the alarm for the walking group. Apparently relief is exhausting.
Walnuts go bitter in the warm cupboard. Move the unopened bag to the freezer.
Invitar a Diego a cenar sin esperar a tener la casa impecable. Una mesa despejada basta.
Aunt's recipe says “a little milk.” We measured it together: roughly half a cup, depending on the flour.
Copied from an old phone: umbrella left on the 18:10 bus. Black handle, crooked silver tip, probably gone forever.
Clinic appointment moved to February 6. Cross out the old date on the fridge calendar.
Put my work notebook in the wrong bag and carried a seed catalog all day. Still managed to remember the important bits.
El vecino me enseñó a ajustar la bisagra. El tornillo de arriba era el culpable del ruido.
New walking route takes forty minutes if I stop at the pond. Saw two herons standing like annoyed officials.
Try borrowing a sewing machine before buying one. First project: shorten the kitchen curtains.
My sister wants the old family photos labeled while Grandma can still tell us who's who. Bring a soft pencil.
Black beans took much longer than the recipe promised. These were probably ancient beans. Check dates before blaming dinner.
Salí de casa con ganas de discutir con el mundo. Una vuelta por el parque y un bocadillo mejoraron bastante el panorama.
Keep train tickets until the entire journey is over. The exit gates needed mine.
Bought the cheaper paintbrush and spent an hour picking bristles off the shelf. Record this for future false economies.
“A small kindness still counts when nobody sees it.” Something I wanted to remember after today.
Annual checkup: bring the list of supplements rather than trying to remember brand names in the room.
En Lisboa me gustaron más las calles pequeñas que los miradores famosos. Guardar una tarde sin planes en el próximo viaje.
A colleague recommended freezing leftover ginger. Tried grating it straight from frozen after work; surprisingly easy.
Birthday plan: breakfast outdoors if dry, museum if wet, cake under all circumstances.
The knitted hat is too wide. Undo the ribbing now instead of pretending my head will grow.
From the old pocket diary: electricity meter photo saved with the moving pictures. Final reading taken before handing back the keys.
La cocina nueva tiene un cajón que se atasca. No llenarlo de paños hasta revisar las guías.
Friends brought soup to the new flat. We ate sitting on boxes. One box was labeled “urgent spoons” and contained no spoons.
Walked the longer route home from work to learn the neighborhood. Found a repair shop and a very good pear tree behind a fence.
Set a reminder to compare energy tariffs in autumn. Introductory rate ends in October.
The tiny balcony gets direct sun from about eleven until two. Herbs might do better there than tomatoes.
Llamar a la tía el domingo. Preguntarle cómo se llama la canción que cantaba mientras cosía.
First attempt at watercolor skies: too much brushing. Leave a patch alone and let the paint do something.
New dentist is beside the post office. Entrance is on the side street, which would have been useful to know this morning.
Took Friday off work for the coast. The weather was terrible and the chips were excellent.
My cousin is a nurse at a hospital in Leeds and says her favorite gift is a meal she doesn't have to plan. Remember for her birthday.
Para la ensalada: garbanzos, pepino, perejil, limón y comino. Añadir el tomate justo antes de servir.
Borrowed binoculars for the marsh walk. A bird that looked completely brown suddenly had six shades and a bright eye.
Emergency fund reached the first little target. Celebrate with a pastry, not an appliance.
Keep a list of books abandoned as well as books finished. Want to remember why, not award myself points.
Work call ended early enough to catch the afternoon light. Photographed the repaired scarf on the balcony.
El radiador del dormitorio vuelve a hacer ruido. Grabar el sonido para enseñárselo al técnico, porque siempre se calla cuando viene alguien.
Imported from my old notes export: Mum's marmalade uses the whole orange, but the seeds go in a muslin bag. Ask about the soaking time.
Return the borrowed suitcase before the end of the month. There's a blue luggage strap inside it that isn't mine.
The ankle feels fine on flat ground, sore on stairs. Write down the pattern before the appointment.
Idea: Sunday dinners where everyone brings one ingredient and we invent the meal together. Maybe establish a backup bread supply.
Entre dos reuniones de trabajo salí a comprar una manzana. Me quedé cinco minutos mirando los árboles de la plaza.
New washing machine filter is behind the small lower flap. Put towels down before opening it.
Finished the mystery on the bus. Guessed the culprit but completely missed the motive, which feels like half a victory.
My nephew wants a telescope for his birthday. Check whether the astronomy group has a lending scheme first.
Saved the campsite address on paper. Phone reception vanished halfway up the valley.
Las fresas del mercado estaban maduras de verdad. Comimos la mitad antes de llegar a casa; el resto acabó con yogur.
Work has been busy enough that dinner keeps becoming toast. Freeze two real meals this weekend.
The bike mechanic tightened the rear wheel and replaced the frayed cable. Braking feels much smoother.
Take Grandma to the garden with the wide paths. She liked the roses but mostly wanted somewhere comfortable to sit and talk.
A useful rule for secondhand furniture: measure the doorway before falling in love.
Tengo ganas de aprender a encuadernar. Buscar un taller corto antes de comprar materiales para cinco años.
The bank fee was refunded after I called. Note the reference number on the paper statement.
Left work on time and made it to the choir rehearsal. Still can't find the first note without hearing someone else.
Old travel note recovered from email: guesthouse breakfast starts at eight; the early train requires buying food the night before.
Kitchen cupboard inventory: three bags of rice, no lentils, enough cinnamon for a small village.
El dentista cambió la cita al día 21. Confirmar la hora en el mensaje antes de salir.
My sister and I finally labeled the family photos. Two unidentified men remain. Grandma thinks one sold bicycles, but isn't sure which.
Bought a small notebook just for garden observations. First observation: I keep forgetting to take it outside.
After work, picked up the repaired boots. New soles cost less than replacing them and they still feel like my boots.
Try the museum on a weekday morning next time. Sunday was mostly a study of other people's backpacks.
La sopa de calabaza quedó demasiado dulce. Un poco de yogur natural y pimienta la equilibró.
Set aside money for the train trip before buying anything for the balcony. The plants can wait.
Clara's spare room window faces the bakery. Woke to warm bread smells and briefly considered never leaving.
Reading thought: I trust a narrator more when they admit what they cannot remember. Might be true in conversation too.
Long work meeting, stiff neck. Raised the screen a little when I got home and booked the eye test I'd postponed.
Comprar hilo azul oscuro para arreglar el bolsillo. El negro se nota más de lo que pensaba.
The shower seal has a gap at the bottom corner. Take a clear photo and get the right replacement strip.
Made a playlist for washing dishes. It needs exactly one song dramatic enough to sing into a wooden spoon.
Vaccination appointment at 10:40 Saturday. Bring the record booklet from the document drawer.
Dad liked the homemade calendar because it had everyone's birthdays already written in. Repeat this gift.
Del cuaderno antiguo: después del trabajo recogí el abrigo de la tintorería. El botón de repuesto está en el bolsillo interior.
The little lemon tree dropped three leaves. Check soil moisture before deciding it needs another drink.
Friend's dinner trick: roast a whole tray of onions and use them throughout the week. Sweetened the lentils beautifully.
Paid back my brother for the shared train tickets. Transfer note says “train,” which is admirably clear for once.
At the ceramics class I made a mug with a handle too small for fingers. It can hold pencils and my humility.
El paseo con papá fue lento y lleno de paradas. Vimos un gato naranja en tres calles distintas, o quizá eran tres gatos.
Brought leftover curry for lunch at work. Next time pack the yogurt separately; everything became lukewarm soup.
Passport renewal reminder set for next spring. Photo requirements deserve checking before I pay for pictures.
The library talk made me want to read diaries again. Ordinary details survive better than grand declarations.
Curtain measurements: window width 142 cm, rail 168 cm, desired drop 205 cm. Measure once more before cutting.
Idea para una tarde de lluvia: cada persona trae una foto antigua y cuenta lo que queda fuera del encuadre.
Camping lesson: a flat-looking patch can become a puddle. Check where water would run before pitching the tent.
A work deadline moved, leaving Thursday evening free. Used it to mend two socks and call my aunt.
The optician adjusted the glasses behind my left ear. Such a tiny change, such a relief.
“Make the next step small enough to begin.” Wrote this above the piano practice list.
La receta de pan necesita más tiempo cuando hace frío. Hoy esperé a que la masa cambiara de verdad y salió mucho mejor.
Holiday expenses stayed within the envelope this year. Buying train tickets early made the biggest difference.
The hall light flickered twice. New bulb first; if it continues, arrange an electrician.
Forgot my water bottle at home and kept meaning to get a drink during work. Put the spare bottle in my bag tonight.
Sunday roast vegetables: carrots need a head start, courgettes do not. Two trays solve this.
La biblioteca tenía el libro que buscaba en la sección de viajes, no en historia. Me gusta cuando una búsqueda termina en otra estantería.
Called Mum while we each made tea. Having the same small ritual made the distance less awkward.
Balcony birds prefer the shallow dish to the fancy feeder. Clean the dish every day.
Trying a five-minute stretch before breakfast. Easy enough to keep doing, which is the point.
Work calls filled the afternoon. Turned the phone off for dinner and actually noticed how good the soup tasted.
Hice una lista de lo que ya hay en el congelador. Dos recipientes misteriosos resultaron ser caldo y compota, por suerte antes de mezclarlos.
My niece sent a drawing of us on the moon. She gave me gardening gloves because apparently space is cold.
Canceled the subscription I kept forgetting about. Small monthly amounts are still amounts.
Finished the long novel in the garden. The last page was quiet enough that I reread it twice.
Bathroom shelf fixed with the correct wall plugs at last. It no longer leans like it has a question.
Después de trabajar hice una caminata sin auriculares. Había olvidado cuánto ruido hacen los pájaros al atardecer.
Eye appointment confirmed for October 29. Bring a book in case there is a wait.
Idea: keep one postcard from each year on the wall, rotating the rest in a box. Less clutter, more looking.
Made orange biscuits and delivered little bags to friends nearby. The uneven ones stayed here and tasted perfectly respectable.
New year, same useful shopping rule: check the cupboard before writing the list.
Mi hermana encontró la bufanda perdida dentro de una funda de almohada. No tenemos una explicación convincente.
Work felt especially slow today. Practicing three piano chords afterward gave me something with a clear beginning and end.
The heating timer was still on the holiday setting. Check that before assuming the boiler has developed a personality.
Appointment questions: is this recurring rash worth photographing, could the new soap matter, when should I come back?
Moved the emergency savings into a separate account. Easier to leave alone when it isn't beside the grocery money.
Sembré albahaca en dos macetas y puse fecha en las etiquetas. Este año quiero saber cuánto tarda en salir.
Dad's old radio still works if the aerial is angled toward the window. We listened to a whole concert without talking much.
A colleague mentioned a walking route, and I tried it after work. The steep bit is short; the view lasts much longer.
Book club chose something under two hundred pages. Everyone sounded relieved.
The picnic blanket needs a waterproof backing. Morning grass soaked through before we finished the tea.
Para recordar el viaje: olor a sal, ventanas verdes, una escalera interminable y el mejor melocotón del verano.
Tightened the loose dining chair screws. Marked the one that keeps loosening so I can check it again.
Friend's birthday is the 18th, dinner is the 20th. Do not merge these into a third imaginary date.
Busy morning at work, quiet afternoon baking bread. Kneading was a better transition than scrolling.
“Enough can be a decision.” Keeping that sentence near the holiday gift list.
Guardar las luces con un trozo de cartón para que no se enreden. Escribir también cuál de los enchufes falla.
Inventory before buying storage boxes: the problem may be too much stuff rather than too few boxes.
Mum wants copies of the moon drawing and the picnic photo. Print two of each so I can keep one.
Tried overnight oats with grated apple. Good texture, too much cinnamon, no need for extra sugar.
Stopped at the pharmacy after work. Refill reminder now set a week earlier so I don't leave it to the last tablet.
La bicicleta hace clic al subir cuestas. Pedir una revisión antes de la excursión, no la víspera.
Saved enough for the weekend trip. Choose the early train and spend the difference on one memorable lunch.
My nephew taught me a card game and changed the rules whenever he was losing. Apparently I used to do this too.
The bathroom extractor fan is loud but barely pulls air. Arrange a clean and inspection.
Started a book about rivers. Already looking at the little stream near home differently.
El trabajo terminó tarde y casi cancelé la cena con Clara. Fui de todos modos; hablar de cosas pequeñas me hizo bien.
Travel packing improvement: one small pouch for every charging cable. No more excavating the whole bag on the train.
First tomatoes from the balcony. Small, split, delicious. Ate them standing by the plant.
Dental cleaning booked for next month. Ask them to check the rough edge on the lower filling.
Idea for gifts: recipe cards in the handwriting of the person who taught me each dish. Ask permission before making copies.
El abrigo ya tiene el forro reparado. La costura quedó torcida por dentro, pero ahora no se engancha la manga.
Finished work early enough to help Dad with the holiday lights. We tested every strand before climbing anything.
The freezer drawer sticks because the bag of peas bulges over the edge. An embarrassingly simple repair.
Compare home insurance using the same excess and coverage. The cheapest headline price wasn't the cheapest equivalent option.
Clara brought a puzzle with no picture on the box. Spent the evening sorting sky from what turned out to be a lake.
La cita médica es en el edificio de al lado, segunda planta. Salir con tiempo porque el ascensor suele tardar.
Chickpea stew improved overnight. Add spinach only to the portion being reheated so it doesn't dissolve into everything.
Work lunch conversation reminded me to renew my passport. Application photo finally taken; I look politely alarmed.
Took Mum to the botanical garden. She remembered the names of flowers I'd forgotten she knew.
Practice drawing hands from life, five minutes at a time. Today's looked like a bundle of carrots, but recognizable carrots.
En el hotel había una tetera diminuta y dos tazas enormes. Tardamos tres tandas en preparar el desayuno, sin ninguna prisa.
The community pool is quieter just after lunch. Remember that the lockers need a coin even though admission takes cards.
Replace the cracked watering can before it becomes two watering cans.
After work, met my brother for a walk instead of dinner. We talked longer and spent nothing.
A sentence from my reading notebook: “Attention is a kind of hospitality.” No author recorded; track down the source before quoting it elsewhere.
Revisar las fechas de las especias. El pimentón viejo casi no huele y no merece ocupar todo ese espacio.
The electrician replaced the worn switch in the hall. Flicker gone. Receipt filed with home repairs.
Made extra soup for my cousin after her long nursing shifts. She asked for the recipe and then admitted she'd rather have another container.
Small plan for January: finish the scarf, book the eye test, use the museum ticket before it expires.
A work meeting was canceled, and I used the free hour to sort receipts. Found the missing bike repair warranty.
Mi sobrina quiere aprender a hacer pan. Empezar con panecillos para que pueda darles formas raras.
The optician says the prescription barely changed. New lenses can wait; the frames just needed adjusting.
Tried a new hiking path with too many layers. Carry the warm jumper instead of wearing it uphill out of stubbornness.
Seeds germinated in the reused food tub. Make drainage holes before the next batch, not after watering.
The short story collection is better read one story a day. Otherwise the endings blur together.
Llevé comida al trabajo tres días esta semana. El ahorro está bien, pero me gustó más no tener que decidir qué comer.
Check the train platform again after buying coffee. It changed while I was admiring the pastries.
My brother found the missing family album in a box of curtains. We spent an hour identifying beaches by their car parks.
Paid the annual fee for the swimming sessions. Going twice a week makes it worthwhile; once a month does not.
Cold dinner worth repeating: white beans, tomatoes, tuna, parsley, lemon, crusty bread. Ten minutes and almost no washing up.
La puerta del balcón cierra mejor desde que limpié el carril. Todavía hay que revisar la goma de la esquina.
Work deadline passed. Celebrated by turning on every lamp, making tea, and reading something with no practical purpose.
Idea: record the sounds of each room for a minute. The kitchen has a refrigerator hum I stop hearing until it stops.
Holiday cards took longer because I wrote an actual memory in each one. Worth starting earlier next year.
Bought replacement buttons for the coat. Sew one inside the hem as a spare, where it won't vanish into a drawer.
La revisión del coche es el jueves. Vaciar el maletero antes; todavía lleva las sillas del picnic de septiembre.
Reading list rule for now: one borrowed book, one already owned. The shelf deserves a turn.
Walked home after work in unexpected sunshine. Picked up daffodils and put them in the chipped jug.
The physiotherapist changed one exercise and asked me to track the soreness afterward. Keep the notes simple: time, movement, how it felt.
My aunt finally named the sewing song. She sang the first verse twice so I could write it down.
Probé la receta de lentejas con zanahoria rallada. Quedó más suave y no hizo falta añadir tanto caldo.
Camping stove test completed on the balcony with plenty of space around it. Fuel canister nearly empty; buy another before packing.
The savings account rate changed. Compare alternatives this weekend and include any withdrawal limits.
A colleague lent me a bird guide; brought it home after work. The mystery balcony visitor was a juvenile blackbird.
Stayed two extra nights by the sea. The best afternoon involved no tickets, no itinerary, and a bench out of the wind.
Comprar una caja pequeña para las fotos sin fecha. No mezclarlas otra vez con las que ya identificamos.
The kitchen sink drained slowly because the trap needed cleaning. Photograph the fittings before taking them apart next time.
Pottery bowl survived the kiln. Slightly lopsided, lovely blue glaze, perfect size for breakfast.
“Keep a little space for an ordinary good day.” My own reminder after making an overambitious weekend list.
Booked a day off work for Mum's appointment. Bring snacks, her question list, and something warm for the waiting room.
Ordenar el cajón de los cables llevó quince minutos. Había guardado tres cargadores de aparatos que ya no tengo.
The winter soup rotation needs something green. Try leek and pea, with lemon at the end.
Dentist appointment confirmed for February 18, 8:50. Put the retainer case beside my keys.
My niece's first loaf looked like a sleeping turtle. She insisted we photograph it before slicing. We did.
Renewed the library card and borrowed a book about local trees. Aim to learn one tree well instead of ten names badly.
Después del trabajo pasé por la zapatería. Las botas estarán listas el sábado; guardar el recibo en la cartera.
Balcony rail planter needs a second bracket. Measure the rail depth before ordering anything.
Started a separate holiday envelope again. A small automatic transfer feels easier than finding the whole amount later.
Clara and I tried the new walking loop. Too much road at the beginning, beautiful woods afterward. Start from the northern gate next time.
Idea for a family afternoon: everyone teaches one small thing. Folding dumplings, fixing a puncture, identifying a bird call.
El tren de regreso iba lleno, pero encontré asiento junto a la ventana. Vi llover sobre campos que aquí seguían secos.
Work ran over, but there was still daylight for a swim. Twenty easy lengths. Glad I had packed the bag in the morning.
The tomato sauce batch filled six containers. Label the spicy two clearly; last year's guessing game was unnecessary.
Dad asked for another calendar with birthdays. Add larger squares this time so he can write appointments without squeezing them into the margins.
Replaced the felt pads under the dining chairs. The room sounds calmer already.
Hoy releí algunas notas antiguas. Había muchas listas y unas cuantas tardes que ya no recordaba. Quiero seguir apuntando las cosas pequeñas.
